استقذرت (form X)
# اِسْتَقْذَرْتُ (istaqḏartu) /is.taq.ðar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَقْذَرَ (istaqḏara)
# اِسْتَقْذَرْتَ (istaqḏarta) /is.taq.ðar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَقْذَرَ (istaqḏara)
# اِسْتَقْذَرْتِ (istaqḏarti) /is.taq.ðar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَقْذَرَ (istaqḏara)
# اِسْتَقْذَرَتْ (istaqḏarat) /is.t
